heading: Collecting arms, etc., with intention of waging war against the Government of India.
text: Whoever collects men, arms or ammunition or otherwise prepares to wage war with the intention of either waging or being prepared to wage war against the [2][Government of India], shall be punished with [1][imprisonment for life] or imprisonment of either description for a term not exceeding ten years, [15][and shall also be liable to fine].
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by the A. O. 1950, for “Queen”.
Subs. by Act 26 of 1955, s. 117 and the Sch., for “transportation” (w.e.f. 1-1-1956).
Subs. by Act 16 of 1921, s. 2, for “and shall forfeit all his property”.
